name: Triply
oneliner: An AI trip planner that builds day-by-day itineraries.
summary: Triply is a trip planning prototype. It generates personalized day plans and multi-day itineraries from your preferences, such as how you get around, budget, and the kinds of places you like, and shows them on a map.
description: Planning a trip usually means juggling a map, a spreadsheet, and a dozen open tabs. Triply takes your preferences (transport, distance, cost, ratings, cuisine) and drafts a day-by-day itinerary with AI.
Activities can be reordered and edited, and each day is shown on a map. It is a Flutter prototype and has not been released.
